verdict.rationale: Segment's pricing page mentions 'Build AI-powered audiences from a complete customer view' and 'Govern data for quality and compliance', suggesting some AI-driven audience/insight capability, but there is no substantive documentation describing how AI-generated insights or suggestions actually surface inside the product (no walkthrough, UI screenshots, or feature docs beyond the marketing tagline). Missing for 10: detailed docs or independent evidence of an AI insights/suggestions feature, specifics on what 'AI-powered audiences' actually computes or recommends, and any hands-on corroboration.
